results.title: Top 10 dictation tools December 2025
results.content:
Universal app support: The best dictation software works everywhere you need to write, not just in specific applications. Email, documents, messaging, code editors, all should support voice typing without switching tools.

High accuracy: Dictation software should achieve 95 percent accuracy or higher out of the box. Lower accuracy means spending more time correcting errors than you saved by not typing.

Natural speech processing: Great voice typing tools understand context, handle technical terminology, and recognize when "their" versus "there" is correct based on meaning.

Speed and responsiveness: Transcription should feel instant. Delays between speaking and seeing text break your flow and make dictation frustrating. [...] Why Wispr Flow wins: Unlike competitors limited to single platforms or specific apps, Flow works everywhere. Speak in Gmail, and it formats professionally. Speak in Slack, and the tone becomes conversational. Speak in Cursor or VS Code, and it recognizes code syntax and variable names.

The AI engine processes over 500 language patterns per second, handling technical terms, names, and mixed-language speech accurately. Flow's developer jargon recognition understands programming terminology automatically, making it the best dictation software for technical work.

results.title: Dictation not responding on MacBook Pro - Apple Community
results.content:
CiaraJoyS

Jan 2, 2025 9:06 AM in response to liamgmail

I, too, was having an issue where all settings were configured correctly. I'd press my keyboard shortcut for dictation (in my case, the F5 mic icon on the MacBook Air), and the microphone would show up as if it was ready to record, but then it wouldn't do anything. I turned the dictation feature on and off, which didn't help. Then I restarted my computer and it spontaneously started working without me changing any settings. It's frustrating that that was the fix, considering I must have turned my computer off since I received it in November, but for some reason, that worked. I would definitely just try the good ole restart fix.

Link

Mar 1, 2024 10:53 AM in response to Junosprite007 [...] rgb2cmyk_

Jun 19, 2024 6:29 AM in response to liamgmail

I had the same issue. What ended up working for me was selecting a different language, for example Canadian English or German. The dictation would work in those languages. Interestingly, if I then changed it back to US English, it also worked again.

Hopefully, it works for you as well.

Link

VellBerry24

Jun 29, 2024 6:42 AM in response to rgb2cmyk\_

Yeeeeees!!!! Just check marking on a different language in "DICTATION" and clicking back to United States, worked for me like magic! Just go to keyboard in your settings and in the keyboard settings, checkmark a different language, then uncheck English, then uncheck the other and recheck English. I never did hit apply. Thanks @rgb2cmyk\_ this was driving me, nuts!
